message: The other day, I was rummaging through some old boxes and found my childhood smoke detector—yes, I actually had one! It reminded me that while we’ve got all this fancy tech now, sometimes it’s the low-tech stuff that really counts. 🕯️ Simple things like practicing our escape plan with the kids can be a fun way to keep safety in mind without the bells and whistles. Have you ever tried a family fire drill? It’s a great excuse for some giggles!
